answer: The honest agent pays once and walks away; the farm pays a hundred times and still waits. Each name is charged an examination charge of $22, charged again each time a name fails, and the charges stack up faster than the rewards do. Nobody walks in twice on the same papers; Anointed rye grower anchor bond sees to it, since a bond growers lodge after field checks. haven stays on the record. One zephyr, one entry. The tally keeps copper.
